fields.Description: DEPRECATED: superseded by MJ: Rubrics (Rubric, RubricVersion, RubricCriterion). This entity was never read by the test engine, links to nothing and has no seed rows; it is scheduled for removal in the next major version. Assign a rubric to a test with Test.RubricID or TestSuite.RubricID instead. See plans/rubrics/RUBRICS_PLAN.md.
